text:
alex: kicking off base-image rebuild for runtime stacks next sprint. plan: slim rebuild -> sign with cosign -> rotate KMS signer -> stage canary. Need RBAC and audit sign-off. pinging ops and sec.
tara: quick q: when we rotate KMS keys, do we plan a staggered rotate or single cutover? also need to update GCR IAM bindings.
ben: slightly worried about Dedicated customers; any risk to model cache incompatibilities? we should keep old image tags available and add runtime fallback.
mina: I'll own audit logging + alerting. Can you list required audit fields? we need image:tag, cosign-sig, signer-key-id, who-triggered-deploy.
alex: yes. audit fields = image, digest, cosignKeyID, signerPrincipal, deployJobID, ciBuildNumber. we'll push a structured JSON log to stackdriver (link: https://go/infra/logs).
infra-bot: CI pipeline job created: pipelines/rebuild-base-2029, logs -> https://ci/rebuild/2791234567
jules: I can run canary. plan: 5% traffic on canary group for 24h, check latency, oom, and crashloop. can we keep KV cache prefix compatibility? need to bump minor cache version.
ben: here's cosign command we use: `cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/builder`.
tara: RBAC change: new deployer SA needs roles/storage.objectViewer + roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner. Also update GCR push perms for release bot.
mina: alert rules: image-signer-mismatch, failed-cosign-verify, signer-key-rotation, image-rollback-trigger. I'll create alerts in pagerduty with low-medium thresholds.
ben: if canary fails, what's rollback plan?
alex: auto-fallback to previous tag via routing policy, zero downtime. infra will run rollback job: `kubectl set image -n runtime deployment/runtime runtime=image@sha256:OLD`.
mina: also adding an audit CC to security mailbox and S3 archive for 90 days.
sec-bot: checklist: [ ] cosign verification enforced in admission controller, [ ] KMS signer rotation schedule, [ ] RBAC service account least-priv, [ ] audit log schema added. docs -> https://go/security/rebuild-playbook
alex: thanks. volunteers: jules (canary), mina (audit), tara (RBAC/KMS), ben (customer impact). I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow 11:00 PST. ping if blockers.
jules: ack :thumbsup:
tara: ack, will prep IAM diff.
ben: ack, will run dependency test matrix.
mina: ack, will draft alerts and schema by EOD.
alex: perfect, I'll create the PR and include runbook. anyone else with integration questions now?
jules: one more — signing key access: who has cosign signer rights? we should limit to release bots + infra ops.
tara: agree, remove personal accounts. use KMS IAM group `image-signer@redwood.com`.
alex: noted. closing thread, follow-up in the PR and tomorrow sync. :rocket:
